name: Panta 30 Minute DPF Peterbilt Fault Code Reference
source: 30 Minute DPF Clean - Understanding Peterbilt Fault Code List
usage_note: Curated from the user-supplied source. Preserve the source's P-code terminology and exact descriptions. The page contains duplicate codes and some questionable SPN summaries; those should not override higher-confidence OEM/controller-specific references. A code description is a diagnostic clue, not proof a component failed.

documents.title: Peterbilt BPV, boost, exhaust pressure and air faults
documents.summary: The source lists BPV position/CAN/actuator/current/temperature/power/calibration faults, post-air-temperature BPV range faults, broken turbine, pre-BPV air pressure low/high, DOC pressure high/low, and boost/exhaust/pre-DOC pressure plausibility faults.

documents.title: Peterbilt fuel and rail-pressure faults
documents.summary: The source includes fuel-temperature plausibility, rail-pressure buildup, low fuel-pressure warning, rail pressure over-threshold, insufficient low-pressure supply, high-pressure dump-valve current, hot fuel, clogged fuel filter, rail-pressure calibration and rail-pressure gradient faults.

documents.title: Peterbilt injector, combustion and misfire faults
documents.summary: The page maps individual cylinders to injector needle-valve open/short-to-ground/short-to-battery faults, grouped high-side injector faults, spill-valve faults, cylinder combustion imbalance and intermittent misfire faults. Preserve exact cylinder/code rather than assuming an injector replacement.

documents.title: Peterbilt crank, cam, VGT and EGR faults
documents.summary: The source covers no/corrupt crank and cam signals, possible long crank, VGT status/data/learn/power/temperature faults, EGR rate and cooler-temperature faults, EGR CAN actuator faults, stuck-open/stuck-closed EGR, and EGR-related fuel derate/PM/SCR-heating states.

documents.title: Peterbilt DEF/urea and derate faults
documents.summary: The source lists urea consumption, dosing, EGR-system, monitor-system and urea-quality categories, torque reduction, staged urea-level warnings, vehicle-speed limitation and engine-speed limitation. Diagnose the underlying DEF/SCR/EGR condition rather than treating the inducement code as the root cause.

documents.title: Peterbilt coolant, oil, battery and 5V reference faults
documents.summary: The page includes high coolant-temperature warning, high oil-system temperature, low oil-level startup warning, oil pressure high/low, coolant-level sensor plausibility/range/low-level, low battery supply, oil-temperature signal faults and 5V sensor-reference high/low faults.

documents.title: Peterbilt NOx, SCR and regeneration-related faults
documents.summary: The source provides extensive upstream NOx/lambda sensor plausibility, heater, message-rate, data-availability and signal faults, NOx-control deviation/governor faults, SCR heating-mode diagnosis, BPV/exhaust-pressure/VGT diagnostics and a regeneration-timeout fault.

documents.title: How Panta should use the 30 Minute DPF Peterbilt list
documents.summary: Use this source as a supplemental P-code lookup. The page itself contains duplicate P-codes with differing descriptions and its later 'common SPN' section includes mappings that conflict with established J1939 references. Therefore exact controller/engine context and higher-confidence OEM/controller-specific sources should take priority when sources conflict.
